apps.name: ARDecipher
apps.author: databhor; Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors
apps.description: ARDecipher di databhor: un rompicapo in cui forzi un terminale. Trova la password tra le parole in 5 tentativi: ogni errore ti dice quante lettere erano al posto giusto.
apps.license: MIT (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)

apps.name: Ardu Buggy
apps.author: NonoNano; Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors
apps.description: Ardu Buggy di NonoNano: guida il rover lunare tra crateri e rocce, saltando e sparando lungo il percorso.
apps.license: Unlicense (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)

apps.name: ArduboyLife
apps.author: Scott Allen (MLXXXp); Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors
apps.description: ArduboyLife di Scott Allen: il Gioco della vita di Conway, il celebre automa cellulare, con configurazioni casuali o disegnate e velocità regolabile.
apps.license: MIT (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)

apps.name: ARDUBULLETs
apps.author: obono; Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors
apps.description: ARDUBULLETs di OBONO: uno sparatutto bullet hell. Infilati tra fitte raffiche di proiettili e sconfiggi la squadriglia nemica entro un minuto.
apps.license: MIT (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)

apps.name: ArduLO
apps.author: Jon Thysell; Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors
apps.description: ArduLO di Jon Thysell: il classico rompicapo delle luci. Ogni pressione accende o spegne una luce e le vicine: spegnile tutte.
apps.license: MIT (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)

apps.name: Beam 'Em Up
apps.author: unwiredben; Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors

apps.license: Apache-2.0 (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)

apps.name: Boris goes skiing
apps.author: Tom Sparrow (sones857); Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors
apps.description: Boris Goes Skiing di Tom Sparrow: attraversa la strada, noleggia gli sci e scendi nello slalom tra bandierine e alberi. Un omaggio a un classico dello ZX Spectrum.
apps.license: MIT (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)

apps.name: Box Stacker
apps.author: dragula96; Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors

apps.name: Chie Magari Ita
apps.author: obono; Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors

apps.name: Chri-Bocchi Cat
apps.author: obono; Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors

apps.name: CosmicPods
apps.author: cubic9com; Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors

apps.name: Crate Confusion

apps.name: Dark & Under

apps.name: Diamonds

apps.name: Dominoes: All Fives

apps.name: Evade

apps.name: Galaxion

apps.name: Glove

apps.name: Hangman
